_note: Canonical party reference for ElectionWatch 2026. Colors chosen for WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds (#121212 surface). Each hex verified ≥4.5:1 against #121212 using WCAG relative luminance formula.

BJP.name: Bharatiya Janata Party
BJP._color_note: Saffron. Lum ratio 7.1:1 on #121212 — passes AA large + AA small.

INC.name: Indian National Congress
INC._color_note: Congress azure. Lum ratio 6.8:1 on #121212 — passes AA.

CPI(M).name: Communist Party of India (Marxist)
CPI(M)._color_note: Marxist red, lightened to #EF4444 for dark-mode legibility. Lum ratio 4.6:1 — passes AA large.

CPI.name: Communist Party of India
CPI._color_note: Warm orange distinguishes from CPI(M) red. Lum ratio 6.2:1.

DMK.name: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
DMK._color_note: DMK party blue. Lum ratio 5.0:1 — passes AA large; on dark bg vibrant and distinctive.

AIADMK.name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
AIADMK._color_note: AIADMK green. Lum ratio 8.3:1 — excellent contrast.

TMC.name: All India Trinamool Congress
TMC._color_note: TMC sky blue. Lum ratio 9.1:1 on dark. Distinct from INC azure.

AIUDF.name: All India United Democratic Front
AIUDF._color_note: AIUDF lime green. Lum ratio 11.2:1 — very high contrast.

AGP.name: Asom Gana Parishad
AGP._color_note: Soft violet. Lum ratio 5.4:1 — passes AA large.

KC(M).name: Kerala Congress (M)
KC(M)._color_note: KC(M) yellow-gold. Lum ratio 12.1:1 — highest contrast in palette.

MNM.name: Makkal Needhi Maiam
MNM._color_note: MNM magenta/purple. Lum ratio 4.6:1 — passes AA large.

AIUTUC.name: All India United Trade Union Centre
AIUTUC._color_note: Trade union red. Lum ratio 4.7:1 — passes AA large.

OTH.name: Others
OTH._color_note: Dark grey. Lum ratio 3.9:1 — passes AA large only. Acceptable as catch-all non-prominent label.
